notes: Spine: need -> dual-function hypothesis -> NH4OAc modification -> single-ion electrolyte set -> plating/stripping -> branch A (NH4+ adsorption shield MEC -> dendrite-free deposit STR) and branch B (OAc-/HOAc buffer MEC -> no ZHSH by-product STR) -> joint causes of high CE (PRP) -> 3500 h symmetric cell and 83.7% full-cell retention (PRF) -> conclusion. Controls: single-additive lifetimes (n17 contrasts n13), ZHSH with NH4+ alone (n18 contrasts n10). Audit: o12 (ZHSH marker remains on NH4OAc XRD, qualifies n10). F1b cited without panel id (OCR cue XPS on a DFT bar chart). F2c not offered; F4 has no panels. Not in graph: SI-only claims (general applicability to Zn(OTf)2/Zn(OAc)2/ZnCl2, high DOD, 10 mA cm-2 5000 cycles, NH4+ ~8% capacity contribution); F4a CV and F4b profiles in o18 image_note. NH4OAc was chosen a priori per the linked text, so n3 is DES/modification, not down_select.
